title: Know your phone, and where you are starting from

say: Know your phone, and where you are starting from.
This is the video for module 1 of Foundational Digital Skills.
Many women say, I am not good with phones. The truth is more specific. You may send voice notes all day but never open settings.
A framework called DigComp splits digital skill into five areas. The first is information: finding, checking and storing it.

panel.heading: Digital skill is five areas, not one

say: The second is communication, like voice notes and video calls.

panel.heading: Digital skill is five areas, not one

say: The third is creating content, like a price list photo.

panel.heading: Digital skill is five areas, not one

say: The fourth is safety: protecting your phone, money and privacy.

panel.heading: Digital skill is five areas, not one

say: The fifth is problem solving, like freeing space when storage is full. You can be strong in some and new to others.

panel.heading: Digital skill is five areas, not one

say: Score ten everyday phone tasks. 0 means I cannot do it. 1 means slow or unsure. 2 means easy on my own. Be honest. An honest 0 is more useful than a hopeful 2.

say: Swipe down from the top of the screen for Quick Settings, with switches for Wi-Fi, mobile data and airplane mode. Wi-Fi does not use your bundle.

panel.heading: Find out where your data goes
items: Find the app at the top of the list
Set a data warning below your bundle

say: Then open Settings, tap the magnifying glass, and type data usage.

panel.heading: Find out where your data goes
items: Find the app at the top of the list
Set a data warning below your bundle

say: For example, Bisi in Ibadan buys a 3 GB bundle, and it ran out after 18 days. TikTok had used 1.8 GB. That is 60 percent of her bundle.

panel.heading: Find out where your data goes
items: Find the app at the top of the list
Set a data warning below your bundle

say: She turned on Data Saver, which stops apps in the background from using mobile data. In WhatsApp, she set auto-download on mobile data to No media.

panel.heading: Find out where your data goes
items: Find the app at the top of the list
Set a data warning below your bundle

say: You can also set a data warning, for example at 2.5 GB of a 3 GB bundle.

panel.heading: Find out where your data goes
items: Find the app at the top of the list
Set a data warning below your bundle

say: Updates fix security holes. A pop-up or WhatsApp message telling you to download an urgent update is a trick. Check Settings yourself.

panel.heading: Find out where your data goes
items: Find the app at the top of the list
Set a data warning below your bundle
panel.rule: Real updates come only from Settings or the Play Store.

say: Do these five checks once a month. Check data usage. Turn on Data Saver if your bundle is low. Make the text size comfortable, so you are not squinting.
Check for a system update, and update your apps in the Play Store, on Wi-Fi with the battery above half.
Exploring settings cannot damage your phone. Almost everything can be changed back.

panel.heading: Monthly settings check
items: Data Saver on if bundle is low
Apps updated in the Play Store

say: For example, Halima in Kano gets a message from her fabric supplier: pay 45,000 to an account number. Step 1. She presses and holds on the number until two small handles appear.

panel.heading: Copy an account number safely
items: Press and hold until handles appear
Drag the handles over all ten digits
In your bank app, hold and tap Paste
Compare the account name before paying

say: Voice typing helps when typing is slow. Tap the microphone on the keyboard and speak. It can mishear names and numbers, so read before you send.

Power plus Volume down. Crop out private details, then tap Share.
Open the Files app, tap Downloads, sort by date. Rename important PDFs.

say: To take a screenshot on most Android phones, press Power and Volume down together. Crop out your balance or other people's messages before you share it with the Share button.

say: To remember. Your zeros are starting points. Data usage shows which app eats your bundle. Update only from Settings or the Play Store. Copy account numbers, then always check the account name. And crop private details before you share.
